27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: The makeup girl dusted my cheeks with one last coat of powder as the lights in the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation studio flickered to life.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: Back during the '53 election, I had debated my political opponents on the radio. Now the debate was to be televised, like everything else these days.

31.speaker: Player_Italic
31.text: Take a sip of something strong.

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: The moderator walked in and sat at her desk. I recognized her as a former SBC reporter I'd encountered on a number of occasions. She nodded to me and the others.

33.speaker: Moderator
33.text: "We'll begin in just a few minutes. I'm looking forward to an evening of polite and civil discourse."

34.speaker: Player
34.text: "Just don't forget who you work for."

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: She forced a smile before turning back towards the cameras. After a quick countdown, we were live.

41.speaker: Narrator
41.text: She smiled at me gratefully before turning back towards the cameras. After a quick countdown, we were live.

42.speaker: Moderator
42.text: "Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. The Sordish Broadcasting Company is pleased to welcome all candidates in the 1957 Sordish presidential election."

43.speaker: Moderator
43.text: "To my left is Anton Rayne, the incumbent president of Sordland."

60.speaker: Moderator
60.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_LileasGraf"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_FrensRicter"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_KesaroKibener"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Faction_PFJP_Destroyed"] == true)

61.speaker: Denis Stahler
61.text: "That's right. The President may have tried to silence me, but he couldn't silence our movement. The poor and downtrodden of Sordland *will* unite and rise up."

62.speaker: Moderator
62.text: "To my right, Lileas Graf, former Interior Minister and leader of the USP."

66.speaker: Moderator
66.text: "Our last candidate is Denis Stahler of the Communist Party."
66.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_LileasGraf"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_MansounLeke"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_FrensRicter"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_KesaroKibener"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_RemusHolstron"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Faction_PFJP_Destroyed"] == true)

68.speaker: Moderator
68.text: "Mansoun Leke of the Bludish Workers' Party -- formerly an independent Assembly member."
68.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_LileasGraf"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_MansounLeke"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_FrensRicter"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_KesaroKibener"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_RemusHolstron"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Faction_PFJP_Destroyed"] == true)

69.speaker: Moderator
69.text: "Remus Holstron, new chairman of the NFP."
69.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_LileasGraf"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_FrensRicter"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_KesaroKibener"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_RemusHolstron"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Faction_PFJP_Destroyed"] == true)

73.speaker: Frens Ricter
73.text: "A new era of freedom and justice is about to begin."

74.speaker: Moderator
74.text: "Manoly Suheil, new leader of the PFJP."
74.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_LileasGraf"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_FrensRicter"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Faction_PFJP_Destroyed"] == true) == false)

75.speaker: Manoly Suheil
75.text: "It's an honor to be here. Despite the circumstances."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: Remus stiffly saluted. The "Iron Wall" had never been much for words.

78.speaker: Mansoun Leke
78.text: "Indeed. The great Fetih Ejall and I once dreamed of a lasting peace for Bludia and Sordland. After his departure, I have recommitted to that dream and to my party."

81.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_MansounLeke"] == true  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Threshold_Default"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Threshold_15"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == true)) == false

82.speaker: Narrator
82.text: Stahler looked at me, his eyes full of fury. A year in prison hadn't dulled his edge. Quite the opposite.

83.speaker: Denis Stahler
83.text: "And of the People's Front coalition. Together, we will not be silenced. The poor and downtrodden of Sordland *will* unite and rise up."
83.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Ban_RedYouth"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_MansounLeke"] == true  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Threshold_Default"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Threshold_15"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == true))

84.speaker: Denis Stahler
84.text: "That's right. We may have failed to meet the threshold last time, but the poor and downtrodden of Sordland *will* unite and rise up."
84.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Ban_RedYouth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Debate_Enable_MansounLeke"] == true  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Threshold_Default"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Threshold_15"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == true)) == false)

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: I thought I saw Frens roll his eyes. He and Denis had been fierce rivals since the latter left the PFJP decades ago.

89.speaker: Moderator
89.text: "Now that everyone's been introduced, let's proceed to the questions."

96.speaker: Lileas Graf
96.text: "And protector of the legacy of Tarquin Soll, God rest his soul. I'm looking forward to your questions."

97.speaker: Lileas Graf
97.text: "And protector of the legacy of Tarquin Soll, lest we forget. I'm looking forward to your questions."

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: She shot a pointed glance in my direction.
